request.what: Funding for Hydra v2 workstreams covering performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience/maintenance.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and says the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
Hydra has powered or is powering applications including Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The funded workstreams are expected to deliver performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance/DevX improvements for a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.
Hydra is claimed to provide sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high throughput, and L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The proposer claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment transaction fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making high-performance applications uncompetitive on L1.
The proposer claims a single Hydra Head can process up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly across independent Heads.

The proposal claims Hydra can increase Cardano ecosystem activity, TVL, L1 settlement usage, protocol revenue, and ADA demand by retaining use cases that would otherwise move to Solana or Ethereum L2s.
The proposer claims head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed head fees can create usage-linked L1 fee accrual that scales with Hydra adoption.
The proposal names provisional users under evaluation including Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, and European Public Network.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for milestone-gated Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, with substantial technical and ecosystem-benefit claims but limited budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community-impact analysis in the supplied text.
